name: react-native-ai-agent
description: A React Native focused AI agent and runtime inspector for Visual Studio Code.

scripts.bridge:pack: tsc -b packages/runtime-bridge && mkdir -p outputs && npm pack -w @rn-agent/runtime-bridge --pack-destination outputs
scripts.package: npm run build && mkdir -p outputs && cd packages/vscode-extension && ../../node_modules/.bin/vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out ../../outputs/react-native-ai-agent-0.1.0.vsix
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
